findings.claim: 風險因子：公司長期依賴少數客戶，預期集中度持續；多數客戶以採購單下單、無數量或長期承諾，可能無預警改變採購。
findings.excerpt: We have consistently relied on a small number of customers for a significant portion of our sales. We expect that this customer concentration will continue in the future

findings.claim: 應收帳款集中：2026-06-27 兩家客戶分別占應收帳款毛額 30% 與 11%（前一年 13%、11%）。
findings.excerpt: As of June 27, 2026, our accounts receivable from a single customer, which represented 10% or greater of the total accounts receivable, was concentrated with two customers, which represented 30% and 11% of gross accounts receivable, respectively.

findings.claim: 搜尋未找到主要客戶信用評等下調、破產或財務壓力的來源；10-K 客戶名稱匿名，客戶身分僅來自二手媒體推測。
findings.source: WebSearch 結果彙整（無客戶信用惡化來源）

note: 客戶信用面本軸僅一次搜尋，未查到惡化證據。
